capabilities: Bind notes to furniture and individual books as memory loci
Recall notes along routes with reveal-then-rate prompts and spaced repetition
Build 3D rooms, walls, and furniture, including imported .glb models and photo-to-furniture recognition
Generate AI mnemonic stories and illustrations via an OpenAI-compatible API
Organize palaces as islands, an archipelago, and a tiny planet with scene themes
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is also distributed for SiYuan. It sends no telemetry and talks only to the user-configured OpenAI-compatible API for optional AI features. Detailed user guides are linked externally, one of which is in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review notes using the method of loci, where memories are placed in physical locations and recalled by walking a route.

relations.evidence: A plugin for SiYuan and Obsidian.

summary: 3D memory palace tool that binds notes to furniture in walk-in houses and recalls them along routes with spaced repetition.
